children: Babcock International posts a strong trading update for the first five months of fiscal 2027, J.P. Morgan analysts write. Shares in the U.K. defense group are down around 34% from their high in January and this presents a very attractive entry point for investors, they add. Shares rise 1.3% to 1007.00 pence in early European trade. (adam.whittaker@wsj.com)
